summary_markdown:
A technical discussion occurred regarding a script failure during the recalculation of sessions on a new ClickHouse instance. The initial error was `Permission denied` when trying to write to `clean.log`. It was determined that the task runs under the `clickhouse` user, but the log file path was pointing to the administrator's home directory.

Someone suggested redirecting the output to `/var/log/clickhouse/`, but [me] argued this would create an unnecessary log file. The final decision was made for [p1] to remove the explicit redirection of the log file, allowing the output to stream directly into the existing system logs.
decisions: The script's logging mechanism will be updated to prevent writing to a specific local file.
action_items: [p1] will modify the script by removing the line that redirects output to `clean.log`.
